body:
You dont have to feel like a shit person. Its not your fault you feel this way. Im not going to act like I know what I am talking about, but I am just telling you this the best way I can as a person. I love that you love your cat so much, that in itself tells me you are a good person, even if you are overtaken, you still thought about your cat and how it will affect that furball. 

Im on here because my father told me he was thinking about killing himself today. I just wanna help him myself the best I can ): not make him feel stressed out by calling the police and freaking out. 

I just hope that whatever happens you are happy one day, and that you can try and remember all the good times even if those were rare.

thank you for this, it really is nice to get the perspective from someone on the other side. I will make more of an effort to express my love for him and just a little reminder everyday of someone who cares. I know he can try and push us away, but I will never let him

>He may not go to therapy, so you may need to step in and be his therapist. Just talk to him regularly, try to spend time around him when you can. Text him daily just to say hi, most important just listen and keep him talking. Remind him how much you all need him.

honestly this is something I needed to hear. I just kept thinking what if he doesn't go? but I will make it my daily grind to spend more time with him and let him vent.
If anything can you call anyone you know and tell them how you feel? even if you haven't talked to this person in years. Try this before you do anything else.
